readerCopy.body: Something learned the hard way can become useful preparation for a situation that is only beginning to take shape. When Chiron sextiles the North Node, an old mistake, rejection, health concern, difficult conversation, or period of feeling unprepared can help the next decision account for a weak point sooner. Experience becomes especially useful when it changes the question, boundary, preparation, or support built into what comes next.
